correctness.rationale: For each protected vertex, independence yields an exact polynomial sum over connected survivor sets. Complete Prüfer enumeration through n=7, exact unrooted canonicalization and Sturm sign checks establish n<=6 uniform optimality and precisely two 7-node exceptions. Their explicit pairwise polynomial identities and strict competitor inequalities prove both optimizer envelopes for every p in (0,1). Reconstructed verifier executed from its included path without failures.

value.rationale: The event that all occupied habitat patches remain connected is a natural reliability objective, distinct from expected pairwise connectivity or abundance. A sharp seven-patch impossibility boundary, complete two-shape first-exception classification and exact thresholds give useful structural information about reliability-sensitive single-site conservation planning. No general graph theorem or ecological field prediction is claimed.
